title: 重新思考用户编码器：路由扩散状态以实现场景自适应用户表征
summary: 该论文提出FINDERS框架，利用扩散语言模型（dLLM）的迭代去噪过程作为多粒度重建空间，通过去噪、因子化、路由和压缩四个操作，结合轻量级路由器动态强调相关槽位方向，实现场景自适应的用户表征学习。在十个工业场景的实验中优于现有方法。
summary_en: The paper proposes FINDERS, a router-equipped diffusion language model framework that leverages iterative denoising as a multi-granularity reconstruction space. Through denoise, factorize, route, and compress operations, it learns scenario-adaptive user representations, outperforming state-of-the-art methods across ten industrial scenarios.
